newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee ends steady at 35.72/73 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee ends steady at 35.72/73 per dollar.

text.p: The India rupee closed at 35.72/73 per dollar on Wednesday, little changed from the day's opening quotes of 35.72/74, dealers said.
They reported two-way movement in the rupee in active trade with the rupee hardening to 35.705 per dollar at one stage during the day before dollar demand caused it to retreat.
The low for the day was 35.7025, a dealer said.
Dealers said the Reserve Bank of India bought dollars between 35.71 and 35.74 rupees.
Rollover of swaps by banks caused forward premia to move up, dealers said. The premia for six-month dollars ended Wednesday at 10.80 percent against 10.50 percent on Tuesday, they said.
